config.record_grain: One row per current Australian Financial Services licence register entry, with the licence holder label, optional ABN/ACN, principal business address components, and licence-register attributes

fields.evidence: Help File p.8 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee ABN or ACN; discovery row 2 shows 85007186003. The abn operation checksum-validates 11-digit ABNs and emits no value for a valid ACN.

Help File p.8 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is explicitly the licensee ABN or ACN; the same mixed column may map to both operations. The acn operation checksum-validates 9-digit ACNs and emits no value for a valid ABN; no suffix inference is used.
Help File p.9: AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL is the locality of the current principal business address; discovery row 2 sample is SOUTHBANK.
Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE is the state from the current principal business address; discovery rows 2-3 sample VIC and NSW.

Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE is the postcode from the current principal business address; discovery row 2 sample is 3006. The postcode operation preserves numeric IDs as strings and does not zero-pad damaged values.
Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY is the country of the principal business address; countries outside Australia are set to International. Discovery rows 2-3 sample Australia.

unmapped_fields.reason: Identifies the register entry, not a supplied canonical ontology field; it is not evidence of legal entity type or legal name.
Licence identifier has no corresponding field in the supplied ontology; it is not mapped to an entity identifier.

Help File p.8 calls this the register entry name and documents both person and organisation formats; it is retained via subject_label_field but not mapped to legal_name or trading_name because the source does not establish that it is a legal name or trading name.
Help File p.8 defines this as the AFS licensee/licence start date; it is not company/entity registration and is not mapped to entity.date_registered.
Help File p.9 defines this as previous superseded register identifiers and licence numbers in nested text; the supplied ontology has no licence-history target.

Help File p.11 defines this as current financial-services authorisations/conditions in nested text; the supplied ontology has no licence-condition target, and it does not establish industry, status, legal name, or entity type.

limitations: This is a point-in-time snapshot of current Australian Financial Services licensee register data (Help File p.3); a current licence is not proof of legal-entity active status, and licence changes or revocation do not prove deregistration.
AFS_LIC_NAME is a raw register-entry identity label retained through subject_label_field, not a canonical legal or trading name claim (Help File p.8).
AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is polymorphic; ABN and ACN are independently checksum-validated from the same source column, with no ABN-suffix-to-ACN derivation.
Only principal business locality, state, postcode, and country are available; no street address is supplied, so address.full is unmapped.
The source does not provide a canonical legal-entity type, legal registration date, or row-level entity status; entity.entity_type, entity.date_registered, and entity.status remain unmapped.

The supplied publication timestamp 2026-09-16T21:52:45.982310 is used as an observed-at publication proxy, not a row-change timestamp; other observation-envelope fields are supplied by the ingestion system.
All source-reliability and field-confidence scores are provisional judgements and require human review.
